claim: Low-marsh sediments in the Vellmar Estuary built up faster than local relative sea level rose.
evidence: Accretion in the low marsh, 4.1 mm yr^-1, exceeded relative sea-level rise, whereas the high marsh accreted only 2.3 mm yr^-1.
label: supported

claim: After the roof retrofits, cooling electricity use in the surveyed buildings dropped by roughly a tenth.
evidence: Metered electricity use for cooling in the 418 surveyed buildings fell by 11 percent after normalising for cooling degree days.
label: supported

claim: Meltwater's share of July river flow shrinks from over two thirds near the glacier to under a tenth at the estuary.
evidence: Meltwater made up 68 percent of discharge at the snout gauge, 23 percent at Brennick and 9 percent at the estuary mouth. Mean July water temperature rose correspondingly, from 4.3 degrees C at T1 to 13.8 degrees C at Brennick and 19.6 degrees C at the estuary mouth.
label: supported

claim: Wild bee counts on Brennick farmland fell by 37 percent, mainly because of insecticide spraying.
evidence: Mean wild bee counts per walk fell from 61.2 to 38.6, a 37 percent decline, while hoverflies declined by 21 percent and butterflies by 29 percent.
label: partially_supported

claim: The CoolCrown coating cut afternoon heat island intensity from 3.9 to 3.1 degrees C and also lowered winter heating bills.
evidence: Afternoon heat island intensity in treated districts fell from 3.9 degrees C in 2019 to 3.1 degrees C in 2022, whereas in control districts it changed little, from 3.8 to 3.7 degrees C.
label: partially_supported

claim: The Vellmar high marsh vegetation is dominated by a single grass species.
evidence: Sediments were organic-rich throughout, with a mean organic carbon content of 7.8 percent of dry mass and a mean dry bulk density of 0.71 g cm^-3. Organic carbon content increased landward, from 5.9 percent in the low marsh to 10.4 percent in the high marsh, while bulk density decreased in the same direction, from 0.95 to 0.46 g cm^-3.
label: unsupported

claim: Saelvik Glacier lost more ice mass than any other glacier in the region.
evidence: Saelvik Glacier covered 14.2 km^2 in 2024, down 19 percent from 17.5 km^2 in 2003, and its terminus retreated by a mean of 31 m per year over the same period.
label: unsupported

claim: Butterfly numbers on the Brennick transects peak in July each year.
evidence: Recorders counted all wild bees, hoverflies and butterflies seen within 2 m on either side of the transect line. Wild bees and hoverflies were identified to species where possible and otherwise to one of 11 morphogroups, while butterflies were identified to species.
label: unsupported

claim: High-marsh carbon burial increased by 22 percent between 1960-1989 and 1990-2019.
evidence: Low-marsh burial rose slightly between the two intervals, while high-marsh burial fell by 22 percent, from 140 to 109 g C m^-2 yr^-1.
label: contradicted

claim: At Brennick, each 10 m^3/s of extra meltwater lowers daily mean river temperature by about 1.6 degrees C.
evidence: At Brennick, each 10 m^3/s increase in meltwater discharge was associated with a 0.62 degrees C lower daily mean water temperature, after accounting for air temperature.
label: contradicted
